Prerequisite(s): Paladin 4, effortless armor spell

Benefit: You may cast Effortless Armor as a 1st-level spell instead of 2nd. At 7th paladin level (or higher), you may also increase the spell's duration to '10 minutes/level'. If you do not have the paladin spellcasting class feature, you may take this talent to gain the ability to cast the effortless armor spell as a spell-like ability by spending 1 holy point (the 7th-level effect may still apply).
